result.stdout:
Usage: [command] [-h|--help] [--version]

Commands:
  check    Validate an OKF bundle directory for structural and content issues.
  graph    Generate an OKF graph file for the bundle.
  view     Generate an Obsidian-style single-file reader (index.html) plus a full body+nav okf.json.
 Always builds with concept bodies and the index-driven nav tree.
 Default writes both files into the bundle root (overwrites an existing compact okf.json).

result.stdout:
Usage: graph [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Generate an OKF graph file for the bundle.

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    Path to the bundle directory. [Default: .]

Options:
  -o, --out <string?>                Output path for the generated graph file. [Default: okf.json, or okf.js with --js]
  -b, --body                         Include body content in the graph. [Default: false]
  --nav                              Include index-driven navigation tree (nav). [Default: false]
  --js                               Emit a plain JS script that sets window.data (loadable via <script src> on file:// too). [Default: false]
  -q, --quiet                        Only render errors and warnings. [Default: false]
  --json                             Output validation issues as JSON instead of human-readable text. [Default: false]
  -p, --properties <string[]?>...    Properties in format Key=Value. Can be repeated.

result.stdout:
Usage: view [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Generate an Obsidian-style single-file reader (index.html) plus a full body+nav okf.json.
 Always builds with concept bodies and the index-driven nav tree.
 Default writes both files into the bundle root (overwrites an existing compact okf.json).

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    Path to the bundle directory. [Default: .]

Options:
  -o, --out <string?>    Output directory, or path to index.html / okf.json (see design). Extension-less paths are directories. [Default: bundle root] [Default: null]
  --name <string?>       Display name in the HTML title. [Default: directory name] [Default: null]
  --open                 Open the generated index.html in the default browser. [Default: false]
